title: Considering replacing with glass set
text:
Considering replacing with glass set. My 7 year old and I have been eyeing the cute decorated mason jars from the colormadehappy blog. When I saw these, I thought they’d be perfect for her since they obviously wouldn’t break like glass. After I opened them though, I’ve been debating for the past week whether or not to waste paint on these or to just go buy glass ones, which I could get 12 for $12 at Walmart.

These feel pretty thin and cheap. The metal lid is only one piece (unlike glass ones with the two piece lids), and the metal is super thin. One lid was bent when I opened the box. I’m sure with actual use they will get more dinged up. Also the small size is very itsy bitsy. Definitely not large enough to hold most art supplies I would like to store, possibly good for sequins or tiny pom poms. Overall I was very unimpressed.
